name: workmail
description: WorkMail is a secure, managed business email and calendaring service with support for existing desktop and mobile email clients.

subcommands.name: associate-delegate-to-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a member (user or group) to the resource's set of delegates.

subcommands.name: associate-member-to-group
subcommands.description: Adds a member (user or group) to the group's set.

subcommands.name: assume-impersonation-role
subcommands.description: Assumes an impersonation role for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: cancel-mailbox-export-job
subcommands.description: Cancels a mailbox export job.

subcommands.name: create-alias
subcommands.description: Adds an alias to the set of a given member (user or group) of WorkMail.

subcommands.name: create-availability-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an AvailabilityConfiguration for the given WorkMail organization and domain.

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a group that can be used in WorkMail by calling the RegisterToWorkMail operation.

subcommands.name: create-identity-center-application
subcommands.description: Creates the WorkMail application in IAM Identity Center that can be used later in the WorkMail - IdC integration.

subcommands.name: create-impersonation-role
subcommands.description: Creates an impersonation role for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: create-mobile-device-access-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a new mobile device access rule for the specified WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: create-organization
subcommands.description: Creates a new WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: create-resource
subcommands.description: Creates a new WorkMail resource.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a user who can be used in WorkMail by calling the RegisterToWorkMail operation.

subcommands.name: delete-access-control-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes an access control rule for the specified WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: delete-alias
subcommands.description: Remove one or more specified aliases from a set of aliases for a given user.

subcommands.name: delete-availability-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the AvailabilityConfiguration for the given WorkMail organization and domain.

subcommands.name: delete-email-monitoring-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the email monitoring configuration for a specified organization.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a group from WorkMail.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-center-application
subcommands.description: Deletes the IAM Identity Center application from WorkMail.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-provider-configuration
subcommands.description: Disables the integration between IdC and WorkMail.

subcommands.name: delete-impersonation-role
subcommands.description: Deletes an impersonation role for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: delete-mailbox-permissions
subcommands.description: Deletes permissions granted to a member (user or group).

subcommands.name: delete-mobile-device-access-override
subcommands.description: Deletes the mobile device access override for the given WorkMail organization, user, and device.

subcommands.name: delete-mobile-device-access-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a mobile device access rule for the specified WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: delete-organization
subcommands.description: Deletes an WorkMail organization and all underlying AWS resources managed by WorkMail as part of the organization.

subcommands.name: delete-personal-access-token
subcommands.description: Deletes the Personal Access Token from the provided WorkMail Organization.

subcommands.name: delete-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified resource.

subcommands.name: delete-retention-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified retention policy from the specified organization.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes a user from WorkMail and all subsequent systems.

subcommands.name: deregister-from-work-mail
subcommands.description: Mark a user, group, or resource as no longer used in WorkMail.

subcommands.name: deregister-mail-domain
subcommands.description: Removes a domain from WorkMail, stops email routing to WorkMail, and removes the authorization allowing WorkMail use.

subcommands.name: describe-email-monitoring-configuration
subcommands.description: Describes the current email monitoring configuration for a specified organization.

subcommands.name: describe-entity
subcommands.description: Returns basic details about an entity in WorkMail.

subcommands.name: describe-group
subcommands.description: Returns the data available for the group.

subcommands.name: describe-identity-provider-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information on the current IdC setup for the WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: describe-inbound-dmarc-settings
subcommands.description: Lists the settings in a DMARC policy for a specified organization.

subcommands.name: describe-mailbox-export-job
subcommands.description: Describes the current status of a mailbox export job.

subcommands.name: describe-organization
subcommands.description: Provides more information regarding a given organization based on its identifier.

subcommands.name: describe-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the data available for the resource.

subcommands.name: describe-user
subcommands.description: Provides information regarding the user.

subcommands.name: disassociate-delegate-from-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a member from the resource's set of delegates.

subcommands.name: disassociate-member-from-group
subcommands.description: Removes a member from a group.

subcommands.name: get-access-control-effect
subcommands.description: Gets the effects of an organization's access control rules as they apply to a specified IPv4 address, access protocol action, and user ID or impersonation role ID.

subcommands.name: get-default-retention-policy
subcommands.description: Gets the default retention policy details for the specified organization.

subcommands.name: get-impersonation-role
subcommands.description: Gets the impersonation role details for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: get-impersonation-role-effect
subcommands.description: Tests whether the given impersonation role can impersonate a target user.

subcommands.name: get-mail-domain
subcommands.description: Gets details for a mail domain, including domain records required to configure your domain with recommended security.

subcommands.name: get-mailbox-details
subcommands.description: Requests a user's mailbox details for a specified organization and user.

subcommands.name: get-mobile-device-access-effect
subcommands.description: Simulates the effect of the mobile device access rules for the given attributes of a sample access event.

subcommands.name: get-mobile-device-access-override
subcommands.description: Gets the mobile device access override for the given WorkMail organization, user, and device.

subcommands.name: get-personal-access-token-metadata
subcommands.description: Requests details of a specific Personal Access Token within the WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: list-access-control-rules
subcommands.description: Lists the access control rules for the specified organization.

subcommands.name: list-aliases
subcommands.description: Creates a paginated call to list the aliases associated with a given entity.

subcommands.name: list-availability-configurations
subcommands.description: List all the AvailabilityConfiguration's for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: list-group-members
subcommands.description: Returns an overview of the members of a group.

subcommands.name: list-groups
subcommands.description: Returns summaries of the organization's groups.

subcommands.name: list-groups-for-entity
subcommands.description: Returns all the groups to which an entity belongs.

subcommands.name: list-impersonation-roles
subcommands.description: Lists all the impersonation roles for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: list-mail-domains
subcommands.description: Lists the mail domains in a given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: list-mailbox-export-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists the mailbox export jobs started for the specified organization within the last seven days.

subcommands.name: list-mailbox-permissions
subcommands.description: Lists the mailbox permissions associated with a user, group, or resource mailbox.

subcommands.name: list-mobile-device-access-overrides
subcommands.description: Lists all the mobile device access overrides for any given combination of WorkMail organization, user, or device.

subcommands.name: list-mobile-device-access-rules
subcommands.description: Lists the mobile device access rules for the specified WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: list-organizations
subcommands.description: Returns summaries of the customer's organizations.

subcommands.name: list-personal-access-tokens
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of your Personal Access Tokens.

subcommands.name: list-resource-delegates
subcommands.description: Lists the delegates associated with a resource.

subcommands.name: list-resources
subcommands.description: Returns summaries of the organization's resources.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags applied to an WorkMail organization resource.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Returns summaries of the organization's users.

subcommands.name: put-access-control-rule
subcommands.description: Adds a new access control rule for the specified organization.

subcommands.name: put-email-monitoring-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the email monitoring configuration for a specified organization.

subcommands.name: put-identity-provider-configuration
subcommands.description: Enables integration between IAM Identity Center (IdC) and WorkMail to proxy authentication requests for mailbox users.

subcommands.name: put-inbound-dmarc-settings
subcommands.description: Enables or disables a DMARC policy for a given organization.

subcommands.name: put-mailbox-permissions
subcommands.description: Sets permissions for a user, group, or resource.

subcommands.name: put-mobile-device-access-override
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a mobile device access override for the given WorkMail organization, user, and device.

subcommands.name: put-retention-policy
subcommands.description: Puts a retention policy to the specified organization.

subcommands.name: register-mail-domain
subcommands.description: Registers a new domain in WorkMail and SES, and configures it for use by WorkMail.

subcommands.name: register-to-work-mail
subcommands.description: Registers an existing and disabled user, group, or resource for WorkMail use by associating a mailbox and calendaring capabilities.

subcommands.name: reset-password
subcommands.description: Allows the administrator to reset the password for a user.

subcommands.name: start-mailbox-export-job
subcommands.description: Starts a mailbox export job to export MIME-format email messages and calendar items from the specified mailbox to the specified Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies the specified tags to the specified WorkMailorganization resource.

subcommands.name: test-availability-configuration
subcommands.description: Performs a test on an availability provider to ensure that access is allowed.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Untags the specified tags from the specified WorkMail organization resource.

subcommands.name: update-availability-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates an existing AvailabilityConfiguration for the given WorkMail organization and domain.

subcommands.name: update-default-mail-domain
subcommands.description: Updates the default mail domain for an organization.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Updates attributes in a group.

subcommands.name: update-impersonation-role
subcommands.description: Updates an impersonation role for the given WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: update-mailbox-quota
subcommands.description: Updates a user's current mailbox quota for a specified organization and user.

subcommands.name: update-mobile-device-access-rule
subcommands.description: Updates a mobile device access rule for the specified WorkMail organization.

subcommands.name: update-primary-email-address
subcommands.description: Updates the primary email for a user, group, or resource.

subcommands.name: update-resource
subcommands.description: Updates data for the resource.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Updates data for the user.
